name: @dhcw/sr-design-system
description: DHCW Single Record Design System — monorepo root. Manages the tokens, web, react, blazor, maui, icons, and storybook packages.

scripts.build-storybook: npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-tokens && npm run build-storybook -w @dhcw/sr-storybook
scripts.build:maui: npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-tokens && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-maui
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:logo && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-tokens && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-web && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-website && npm run build-storybook -w @dhcw/sr-storybook && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
scripts.build:site: npm run build:logo && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-tokens && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-web && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-website
scripts.build:web: npm run build:logo && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-tokens && npm run build -w @dhcw/sr-web
scripts.check: npm run check:type && npm run check:ds && npm run build:maui
scripts.pack:maui: npm run build:maui && dotnet pack packages/maui/nuget/DHCW.SingleRecord.Maui.csproj -c Release -o dist/nuget
